# Synthetic P4 memory fixtures

All files in this directory are **hand-authored synthetic fixtures** written for
the P4 Memory tests. No real client session file was read, copied, or derived:
not from ZCode, Qoder, Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy, or any other tool, and
not from obelisk. Every `unit.json` must keep `"synthetic": true`; the adapter
refuses anything else.

They are not a claim about any vendor's on-disk session format.
